title: Protecting the Executive's Privileges and Enhancing Efficiencies in Federal Contracting
National Adoption Month, 2026
Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Coronavirus Capital Projects Fund Reporting & Recordkeeping
summary: The Department of the Treasury, as part of its continuing effort to reduce paperwork and respondent burden, invites the general public and other federal agencies to comment on the proposed information collections listed below, in accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995.

title: Orano Enrichment USA, LLC; Uranium Enrichment Facility; Draft Environmental Impact Statement
summary: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) is issuing for public comment a draft Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) regarding a license application from Orano Enrichment USA, LLC (Orano) to construct and operate a gaseous centrifuge uranium enrichment facility in Roane County, Tennessee. The draft EIS evaluates the environmental impacts of the proposed action of issuing a license that would authorize Orano to construct and operate a uranium enrichment facility on a 624-acre site, 6.7 miles southwest of Oak Ridge, Tennessee. The environmental impacts of the no-action alternative (i.e., denying the license application) are also evaluated.

title: Establishment of Class E Airspace; Trading Bay Production Airport, Trading Bay, AK
summary: This action establishes Class E airspace extending upward from 700 feet above the surface at Trading Bay Production Airport, Trading Bay, AK. This action supports the safety and management of instrument flight rules (IFR) operations at the airport.

title: Airworthiness Directives; The Boeing Company Airplanes
summary: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain The Boeing Company Model 707 airplanes; Model 720 and 720B series airplanes; Model 727C, 727-100, -100C, -200, and -200F series airplanes; and Model 747-100, -100B, -100B SUD, -200B, -200C, -200F, - 300, 747SR, and 747SP series airplanes. This proposed AD was prompted by reports that using some adaptors while performing tests of the cabin altitude warning switch (CAWS) could lead to incorrect failures. This proposed AD would require repetitive operational tests or replacements of the CAWS and applicable on-condition actions. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed eCollection eComments Requested; Revision of a Previously Approved Collection Title-Crime Victim's Rights Act Complain Form
summary: The Executive Office for United Staes Attorney, Department of Justice (DOJ), will be submitting the following information collection request to the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for review and approval in accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995.

title: Over-the-Counter Monograph Order Requests: Format and Content; Guidance for Industry; Availability
summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of a final guidance for industry titled "Over-the- Counter Monograph Order Requests: Format and Content." This guidance provides recommendations on the format and content of the information that a requestor should provide in an over-the-counter (OTC) monograph order request (OMOR) and identifies relevant guidance documents to assist requestors in preparing their OMORs. This guidance finalizes the draft guidance titled "Over-the-Counter Monograph Order Requests (OMORs): Format and Content" issued on April 13, 2023.

title: Informal Working Group 1 (IWG-1), Informal Working Group 2 (IWG-2), Informal Working Group 3 (IWG-3), and Informal Working Group 4 (IWG-4) of the 2027 World Radiocommunication Conference Advisory Committee (WRC-27 Advisory Committee) Schedule Their Meetings
summary: This notice advises interested persons that Informal Working Group 1 (IWG-1), Informal Working Group 2 (IWG-2,) Informal Working Group 3 (IWG-3,) and Informal Working Group 4 (IWG-4) of the 2027 World Radiocommunication Conference Advisory Committee (WRC-27 Advisory Committee) have scheduled meetings as set forth below. The meetings are open to the public. The meetings are open to the public. Attendees may join via Microsoft Teams (see details, infra). The upcoming Informal Working Group (IWG) meetings in December 2026, January 2027, and February 2027 will focus on developing proposals for future agenda items at the 2027 World Radiocommunication Conference. The full WRC-27 Advisory Committee will meet in the Spring of 2027 to consider items discussed at the upcoming IWG meetings.

title: Auction of Flexible-Use Licenses in the Upper C-Band for Next-Generation Wireless Services; Notice and Filing Requirements, Minimum Opening Bids, Upfront Payments, and Other Procedures for Auction 115; Bidding Scheduled To Begin April 27, 2027
summary: This document summarizes the procedures, deadlines, upfront payment, and minimum opening bid amounts adopted in the Auction 115 Procedures Public Notice for the Federal Communications Commission's (Commission) upcoming auction of 3,248 new flexible-use licenses in the 3.98-4.14 GHz portion of the Upper C-band. The Auction 115 Procedures Public Notice summarized here provides details regarding the procedures, terms, conditions, dates, and deadlines governing participation in Auction 115 bidding, as well as an overview of the post-auction application and payment processes.

title: Mattresses From India: Preliminary Results and Rescission, in Part, of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that producers/exporters subject to this review made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), March 1, 2024, through August 31, 2025. In addition, we are rescinding the review with respect to four companies. Interested parties are invited to comment on these preliminary results of review.

title: Certain New Pneumatic Off-the-Road Tires From India: Final Results of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that certain producers/exporters subject to this review made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), March 1, 2024, through February 28, 2025.

title: Safety Zone; Brownsville Ship Channel, Brownsville, TX
summary: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters on the Brownsville Ship Channel. The safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards associated with an over-sized dead ship tow transiting the area. Entry of vessels or persons into this zone is prohibited unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Sector Corpus Christi, or their designated representative.

title: VIAVI Solutions; Filing of Color Additive Petition
summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or we) is announcing that we have filed a color additive petition, submitted by VIAVI Solutions, proposing that the color additive regulations be amended to provide for the safe use of magnesium fluoride-aluminum flake for use in nail polish at a maximum level of 16 percent of the final product.

title: Notice of Federal Advisory Committee Meeting
summary: The Department of Defense is publishing this notice to announce that the following Federal advisory committee meeting of the Board of Visitors of the U.S. Air Force Academy (BoV AFA) will take place.

title: ANR Pipeline Company; Notice of Request Under Blanket Authorization and Establishing Intervention and Protest Deadline
Commission Information Collection Activities (FERC-549C); Comment Request; Extension
summary: In compliance with the requirements of the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (Commission or FERC) is soliciting public comment on the currently approved information collection, FERC-549C (OMB Control No. 1902-0174), Standards for Business Practices of Interstate Natural Gas Pipelines. The comment period ended on September 8, 2026, with no comments received.

title: Commission Information Collection Activities (FERC-153); Comment Request; Extension
summary: In compliance with the requirements of the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, 44 U.S.C. 3506(c)(2)(A), the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (Commission or FERC) is soliciting public comment on the currently approved information collection FERC-153, Generic Clearance for the Collection of Qualitative Feedback on Commission Service Delivery (OMB Control No 1902-0293). There are no proposed changes to the reporting requirements.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget for Review and Approval; Comment Request; State and EIS Record Keeping and Reporting Requirements Under Part C
summary: In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) of 1995, the Department is proposing an extension without change of a currently approved information collection request (ICR).

title: Petition for Rulemaking To Consider Amendments to Regulations Governing Interim Use of Rights-of-Way as Trails
summary: The Board partially grants a petition for rulemaking and proposes amendments to its regulations implementing section 208 of the National Trails System Act Amendments of 1983 to streamline the railbanking process. Under the proposal, the Board would no longer issue Notices or Certificates of Interim Trail Use during trail-use negotiations. Only after an agreement is reached would the Board issue an order authorizing transfer to the trail sponsor. Abandonment authority would no longer be prerequisite to railbanking. The Board would also confirm that by authorizing transfer the Board is not exercising any power of eminent domain or authorizing a taking.

title: Mid-Atlantic Fishery Management Council (MAFMC); Public Meeting
summary: The Mid-Atlantic Fishery Management Council (Council) will hold public meetings, including joint sessions with the Atlantic States Marine Fisheries Commission (ASMFC) Summer Flounder, Scup, and Black Sea Bass Management Board.

title: 60-Day Notice of Proposed Information Collection: Ginnie Mae Multiclass Securities Program
summary: HUD is seeking approval from the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for the information collection described below. In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act, HUD is requesting comments from all interested parties on the proposed collection of information. The purpose of this notice is to allow for 60 days of public comment.

title: Medicare, Medicaid, and Children's Health Insurance Programs; Provider Enrollment Application Fee Amount for Calendar Year 2027
summary: This notice announces a $776.00 calendar year 2027 application fee for institutional providers that are initially enrolling in the Medicare or Medicaid program or the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP); revalidating their Medicare, Medicaid, or CHIP enrollment; or adding a new Medicare practice location. This fee is required with any enrollment application submitted on or after January 1, 2027, and on or before December 31, 2027.

title: Additions to the Entity List
summary: In this rule, the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) amends the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) by adding 7 entities to the Entity List, under the destinations of Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand. These entities have been determined by the U.S. Government to be acting contrary to the national security or foreign policy interests of the United States.

title: Written Determination: Bicycle Use at Kennesaw Mountain National Battlefield Park
summary: The National Park Service determines that allowing bicycles on approximately 0.85 miles of new and existing multi-use trails within Kennesaw Mountain National Battlefield Park is consistent with the protection of the park's natural, scenic, and aesthetic values; safety considerations; and management objectives; and will not disturb wildlife or park resources.

title: Supervisory Committee Audits And Verifications
summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is amending its regulations governing supervisory committee audits to eliminate unnecessary, redundant, and overly prescriptive provisions. The final rule is necessary to reduce regulatory burden, increase operational flexibility for federally insured credit unions (FICUs), and streamline the rules by removing requirements that are outdated or duplicative of other authorities. The intended effect of the final rule is to simplify compliance for FICUs without compromising the integrity of the audit process.

title: Corporate Credit Unions
summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is amending its regulations for corporate credit unions by removing the requirement that a corporate credit union's asset and liability management committee (ALCO) must have at least one member who is also a member of the corporate credit union's board of directors. The final rule also removes filing requirements related to a corporate credit union's annual report and any management letter or other report issued by its independent public accountant. The intended effect is to reduce unnecessary regulatory burden and provide corporate credit unions with greater flexibility.

title: Compounding Animal Drugs From Bulk Drug Substances: Compounding Under CGMP in Federally-Registered Facilities; Draft Guidance for Industry; Extension of Comment Period
summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or the Agency) is extending the comment period for the notice of availability that appeared in the Federal Register of August 28, 2026. In the notice, FDA requested comments on the draft guidance for industry (GFI) #256B titled "Compounding Animal Drugs from Bulk Drug Substances: Compounding under CGMP in Federally-Registered Facilities." The Agency is taking this action in response to requests for an extension to allow interested persons additional time to submit comments.

title: Thresholds Increase for the Major Assets Prohibition of the Depository Institution Management Interlocks Act Rule
summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing a final rule increasing two thresholds in its regulation implementing management official interlocks for purposes of the Depository Institution Management Interlocks Act (DIMIA). DIMIA authorizes NCUA to adjust the major assets prohibition thresholds through regulation to respond to inflation or market changes. This final rule increases both major assets prohibition thresholds to $10 billion to account for changes in the United States banking market since 1996. Additionally, the final rule removes a presumption related to depository institutions controlled or managed by persons who are members of a minority group or women.

title: Fisheries of the Exclusive Economic Zone Off Alaska; Pacific Ocean Perch in the Eastern Aleutian District of the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands Management Area
summary: NMFS is prohibiting directed fishing for Pacific ocean perch in the Eastern Aleutian district (EAI) of the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands management area (BSAI) by vessels participating in the BSAI trawl limited access sector fishery. This action is necessary to prevent exceeding the 2026 total allowable catch (TAC) of Pacific ocean perch in the EAI allocated to vessels participating in the BSAI trawl limited access sector fishery.

title: Prestressed Concrete Steel Wire Strand From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
summary: As a result of the determinations by the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) and the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on prestressed concrete steel wire strand (PC strand) from the People's Republic of China (China) would likely lead to the continuation or recurrence of dumping, countervailable subsidies, and material injury to an industry in the United States, Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.

title: Information Collection Request; Submission for OMB Review
summary: The Peace Corps is seeking Office of Management and Budget (OMB) approval for the information collection described in this notice. In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, we are requesting comments on this collection from all interested individuals and organizations. The purpose of this notice is to allow 60 days for public comment in the Federal Register preceding submission to OMB.

title: Control of Communicable Diseases; Foreign Quarantine
summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), is extending the expiration date of the interim final rule published on May 27, 2026. This interim final rule removes an exemption for lawful permanent residents from application of regulations implementing section 362 of the Public Health Service (PHS) Act, which authorizes the Secretary, acting through the CDC Director or other delegate, to suspend the introduction of persons from designated countries or places, if required, in the interest of public health.

title: Fisheries of the Exclusive Economic Zone Off Alaska; Atka Mackerel in the Bering Sea Subarea and Eastern Aleutian District of the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands Management Area
summary: NMFS is prohibiting directed fishing for Atka mackerel in the Bering Sea subarea and Eastern Aleutian District (BS/EAI) of the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands management area (BSAI) by vessels participating in the BSAI trawl limited access sector fishery. This action is necessary to prevent exceeding the 2026 total allowable catch (TAC) of Atka mackerel in the BS/EAI allocated to vessels participating in the BSAI trawl limited access sector fishery.

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Revision of an Approved Information Collection; Comment Request; Company-Run Annual Stress Test Reporting Template and Documentation for Covered Institutions With Total Consolidated Assets of $250 Billion or More Under the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act
summary: The OCC, as part of its continuing effort to reduce paperwork and respondent burden, invites comment on a continuing information collection, as required by the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA). In accordance with the requirements of the PRA, the OCC may not conduct or sponsor, and the respondent is not required to respond to, an information collection unless it displays a currently valid Office of Management and Budget (OMB) control number. The OCC is soliciting comment concerning a revision to its information collection titled "Company-Run Annual Stress Test Reporting Template and Documentation for Covered Institutions with Total Consolidated Assets of $250 Billion or More under the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act."

title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Comment Request
Agency Information Collection Activities: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Forms: Applications, Periodic Reporting, and Notices
summary: In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, this notice invites the general public and other public agencies to comment on this proposed information collection. This collection is a revision of the currently approved collection for the applications, periodic reporting, and notices burden calculations for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).

title: Airworthiness Directives; Airbus SAS Airplanes
summary: The FAA proposes to supersede Airworthiness Directive (AD) 2024-19-04, which applies to all Airbus SAS Model A350-941 and -1041 airplanes. AD 2024-19-04 requires a one-time detailed inspection of the engine nacelle anti-icing (NAI) forward bulkhead locating holes for elongation and loose fasteners and applicable corrective actions and prohibits the installation of affected parts under certain conditions. Since the FAA issued AD 2024-19-04, it has been determined that affected parts must accumulate at least 2,000 flight cycles (FC) since installation prior to the inspection to ensure that the inspection will detect discrepancies. This proposed AD would continue to require the actions in AD 2024-19-04 and would amend the compliance time for the inspection. This proposed AD would also prohibit the installation of affected parts under certain conditions. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

title: Certain Pea Protein From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Results, Partial Rescission, and Preliminary Determination of No Shipments of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2023-2025; Correction
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice in the Federal Register on November 16, 2026, in which Commerce announced the preliminary results of the 2023-2025 administrative review of the antidumping duty (AD) order on certain pea protein (pea protein) from the People's Republic of China (China). This notice incorrectly listed the preliminary weighted-average dumping margin (percent) for Yantai T.Full Biotech Co., Ltd. and the non-individually examined companies receiving a separate rate which include Bioway Industrial Group Ltd., Linyi Yuwang Vegetable Protein Co., Ltd., and Yosin Biotechnology (Yantai) Co., Ltd.

title: Tris(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Sales at Less Than Fair Value, Postponement of Final Determination and Extension of Provisional Measures
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that Tris(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane (Tris) from the People's Republic of China (China) is being, or is likely to be, sold in the United States at less than fair value (LTFV). The period of investigation (POI) is October 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

title: Preventing Outages and Enhancing the Resilience of the Electric Grid Formula Grants to States and Indian Tribes
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE or the Department) and National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL) intends to issue on behalf of the DOE Office of Electricity (OE), Amendment 000010 to DE-FOA- 0002736 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA)--Preventing Outages and Enhancing the Resilience of the Electric Grid Formula Grants to States and Indian Tribes in Quarter (Q) 1 Fiscal Year (FY) 2027. Amendment 000010 to DE-FOA-0002736 will provide access to FY 2025 and FY 2026 formula grant allocations, which are available at www.netl.doe.gov/iijahub/grid-resilience. This "Notice of Intent" is for informational purposes only. The Department is not seeking comments on the information in this notice and all information contained in this notice is subject to change.

title: Request for Comments Regarding International Trade Commission's Economic Analysis
summary: Pursuant to Section 332 of the Tariff Act of 1930, the United States International Trade Commission (Commission) is seeking information from the public on its economic analysis, including its methodology and areas of focus.

title: Visiting Committee on Advanced Technology
summary: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Visiting Committee on Advanced Technology (VCAT or Committee) reviews and makes recommendations regarding general policy for the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), an agency within the Department of Commerce (DOC), on its organization, its budget, and its programs, within the framework of applicable national policies as set forth by the President and the Congress. The VCAT will meet virtually on Wednesday, February 10, 2027, from 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

title: Airworthiness Directives; The Boeing Company Airplanes
summary: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain The Boeing Company Model 757-200 and -300 series airplanes. This proposed AD was prompted by a report of missing and/or incorrectly installed lockwire on backshells found during engineering validation tests in the wing leading edge and engine struts for high intensity radiated field (HIRF)/lightning protection features. This proposed AD would require inspection of the backshells at the left- and right-wing leading edge and nacelle strut for missing and incorrectly installed lockwire and applicable on-condition actions. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

title: Federal-State Unemployment Compensation Program: Certifications for 2026 Under the Federal Unemployment Tax Act
summary: The Secretary of Labor signed the annual certifications under the Federal Unemployment Tax Act, thereby enabling employers who make contributions to state unemployment funds to obtain certain credits against their liability for the Federal unemployment tax. By letter, the certifications were transmitted to the Secretary of the Treasury. The letter and certifications are printed below.

title: Establishment of Class E Airspace; Canton, TX
summary: This action proposes to establish Class E airspace at Mother Frances-Canton Heliport, Canton, TX. The FAA is proposing this action to support new instrument procedures and instrument flight rule (IFR) operations.

title: Surface Transportation Project Delivery Program; Ohio Department of Transportation Audit Report
summary: This notice announces the final audit report for the Ohio Department of Transportation (ODOT). The Surface Transportation Project Delivery Program allows a State to assume FRA's environmental responsibilities for environmental review, consultation, and compliance under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) for railroad projects should a State first assume NEPA responsibilities under the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA). When a State assumes these Federal responsibilities, the State becomes solely responsible and liable for carrying out the responsibilities it has assumed, in lieu of FRA. This program mandates annual audits during each of the first 4 years of State participation to ensure compliance with program requirements.

title: Molybdenum-99 Stakeholders Meeting
summary: This notice announces an NNSA Molybdenum-99 (Mo-99) Stakeholders Meeting. This meeting will be held virtually.

title: First Responder Network Authority; Combined Board and Board Committees Meeting
summary: The FirstNet Authority Board will convene a public meeting of the Board and Board Committees.

title: Information Collection Being Reviewed by the Federal Communications Commission
summary: As part of its continuing effort to reduce paperwork burdens, and as required by the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) of 1995, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC or the Commission) invites the general public and other Federal agencies to take this opportunity to comment on the following information collection. Comments are requested concerning: whether the proposed collection of information is necessary for the proper performance of the functions of the Commission, including whether the information shall have practical utility; the accuracy of the Commission's burden estimate; ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information collected; ways to minimize the burden of the collection of information on the respondents, including the use of automated collection techniques or other forms of information technology; and ways to further reduce the information collection burden on small business concerns with fewer than 25 employees.
